name: @conservationtv/agent-runner
description: Runs the agent under Node, and stops it gracefully.

scripts.dev:staging: until curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:5175/health; do sleep 1; done && AGENT_MODE=conservationtv STUDIO_API_URL=http://localhost:5175 tsx --env-file=.env src/index.ts
scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --external:@number0/iroh --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js
